id: 05_Preventing Industrial Laser Sound Shock Innovative Laser Maintenance Tourist Saf
title: 别让突然的响声吓到人（国内版）
source_doc: course/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/05_Preventing Industrial Laser Sound Shock Innovative Laser Maintenance Tourist Saf.md
author_source: project/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/05_Preventing Industrial Laser Sound Shock Innovative Laser Maintenance Tourist Saf（国内版）/src.py

points.K7: 快排放时，别让人站旁边

shots.scene: 欣欣站在激光加工实验室门口，捂着耳朵做受惊状
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the door of a laser workshop, covering its ears with a startled expression.
shots.narration: 这一课讲车间里突然的响声。
overlay: 别让突然的响声吓到人

shots.scene: 储罐、白雾、气动台面、耳罩四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a tall cryogenic tank, a white vapor cloud, a loading table with small balls, and ear muffs. No people.
shots.narration: 响声从哪来，怎么提前防。

shots.scene: 王老师带着几位参观的新同学走进车间，阿杰在后面东张西望
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator leads a small group of visiting new students into a workshop; the young male student looks around curiously at the back.
shots.narration: 新同学来参观激光切割实验室。

shots.scene: 一个高大的低温储罐顶部突然喷出白雾，阿杰吓得往后跳
shots.prompt_en: A tall stainless steel cryogenic tank suddenly vents a white vapor cloud; the young male student jumps back in surprise.
shots.narration: 储罐突然“嗤”地喷出白雾，阿杰吓一跳。

shots.scene: 阿杰后退时差点撞到身后的板材架，小研一把拉住他
shots.prompt_en: As the young male student stumbles backward toward a metal sheet rack, the female graduate student grabs his arm.
shots.narration: 他往后一退，差点撞上板材架。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前摊开双手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot spreads its paws in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 这声音正常吗？该怎么提前防？

shots.scene: 王老师在车间门口给访客讲解，身后是工业设备
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator talks to a group of visitors at the workshop entrance, industrial machines behind them.
shots.narration: 大家都想看激光，这很正常。

shots.scene: 家、办公室的图标，和一个满是机器的车间图标对比
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a home and an office next to an icon of a busy workshop full of machines. No people.
shots.narration: 可访客习惯的是家和办公室。

shots.scene: 王老师走在访客身旁，伸手示意他们跟紧
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks beside the visitors and gestures for them to stay close.
shots.narration: 带进车间，就要时刻照看好他们。

shots.scene: 激光切割机旁，一个压缩空气罐和两个不锈钢低温储罐
shots.prompt_en: Next to a laser cutting machine: a compressed air tank and two stainless steel cryogenic liquid tanks. No people.
shots.narration: 切割要用辅助气体：空气、氮气或氧气。

shots.scene: 储罐上的管路通向切割机
shots.prompt_en: Pipes run from the cryogenic tanks to the laser cutting machine. No people.
shots.narration: 氮气、氧气常以低温液体储存。

shots.scene: 储罐剖面示意：底部是液体，上方是气体，温度计图标很低
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram of a cryogenic tank: liquid at the bottom, gas above, with a very cold thermometer icon. No people.
shots.narration: 罐里的液体极冷。

shots.scene: 外面的热量箭头传入罐内，罐里的压力表指针慢慢上升
shots.prompt_en: Heat arrows flow into the tank from outside while a pressure gauge needle on the tank slowly rises. No people.
shots.narration: 外面的热慢慢传进去，罐里越来越高压。

shots.scene: 储罐顶部的安全阀图标，冒出细细的气流
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a safety relief valve on top of the tank releasing a thin stream of gas. No people.
shots.narration: 压力高了，安全阀就会嘶嘶排气。

shots.scene: 安全阀突然弹起，大声排气的示意
shots.prompt_en: The relief valve suddenly pops open with a loud burst of gas, shown with sound wave lines. No people.
shots.narration: 有时会突然起跳，声音很响。

shots.scene: 欣欣点头，旁边一个绿色对勾和储罐图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods beside a green check mark and a tank icon.
shots.narration: 这是储罐在自我保护，属于正常。

shots.scene: 储罐顶部阀门附近结了一圈白霜
shots.prompt_en: A ring of white frost forms around the valves on top of a cryogenic tank. No people.
shots.narration: 罐顶一圈结霜、挂水珠，

shots.scene: 小研指着结霜的部位，对王老师说话
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at the frosted area on the tank while talking to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 说明压力在升高，快要排气了。

shots.scene: 储罐顶部喷出一大团白雾
shots.prompt_en: A large white vapor cloud bursts from the top of the cryogenic tank. No people.
shots.narration: 排气时，会突然喷出一大团白雾。

shots.scene: 几个访客图标被吓得同时后退
shots.prompt_en: Icons of several visitors stepping back in surprise at the same time. No people.
shots.narration: 没有准备的人，会被吓一大跳。

shots.section_title: 快排放时，别让人站旁边
shots.scene: 王老师张开手臂，把访客带到离储罐较远的位置
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator spreads her arms and guides the visitors to a spot well away from the tanks.
shots.narration: 看到快要排气，别让访客站在旁边。
overlay: 快排放时，别让人站旁边

shots.section_title: 快排放时，别让人站旁边
shots.scene: 王老师指着储罐向访客解释，访客点头
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at the tank and explains to the visitors, who nod.
shots.narration: 先告诉他们：一会儿会响，别怕。

shots.scene: 上料台台面布满小滚珠，旁边一个控制按钮
shots.prompt_en: A loading table covered with small transfer balls, with a control button box on the side. No people.
shots.narration: 上料台的滚珠是用气顶起来的。

shots.scene: 老李按下按钮，滚珠“砰”地升起
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses the button and the transfer balls pop up with a sound wave icon.
shots.narration: 一按按钮，会“砰”的一声升起。

shots.scene: 一个背对台面的访客图标，被声音吓得一抖
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a visitor with their back to the table flinching at a sudden sound. No people.
shots.narration: 背对着、第一次来的人，最容易受惊。

shots.scene: 老李先举手示意，访客都看向台面
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer raises his hand to signal first, and all visitors turn to look at the table.
shots.narration: 动作之前，先打招呼再操作。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在储罐旁，身后浮现雪花、空气、火焰三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a cryogenic tank with three icons behind: a snowflake, an air symbol, and a flame.
shots.narration: 低温液体还有三种真正的危险。

shots.scene: 手碰到结霜管路的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand touching a frosted pipe, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 一是冻伤：结霜的管和阀不能摸。

shots.scene: 密闭小房间里氮气充满，一个人形图标头晕
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a small closed room filling with nitrogen gas and a person icon feeling dizzy. No people.
shots.narration: 二是窒息：液氮汽化会挤走氧气。

shots.scene: 液氧储罐旁的油污和火苗图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of oil stains and a flame next to a liquid oxygen tank, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 三是助燃：液氧旁严禁油脂和明火。

shots.scene: 储罐直立放在通风良好的位置，用链条固定
shots.prompt_en: A cryogenic tank stands upright in a well-ventilated area, secured with a chain. No people.
shots.narration: 储罐直立固定，放在通风好的地方。

shots.scene: 安全阀被布盖住的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a relief valve covered with a cloth, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 安全阀不能堵，排气口不能对着人。

shots.scene: 老李戴着防寒手套和面罩检查储罐阀门
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer, wearing cryogenic gloves and a face shield, checks the tank valves.
shots.narration: 阀门由经过培训的人操作，访客不碰。

shots.scene: 受惊后退的人撞到板材架的示意图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a startled person stepping backward into a sheet metal rack. No people.
shots.narration: 受惊本身也会伤人：后退、碰撞、摔倒。

shots.scene: 访客站在地面黄线标出的安全区内
shots.prompt_en: Visitors stand inside a safe area marked by yellow floor lines, away from machines.
shots.narration: 参观时站在划定的安全区里。

shots.scene: 王老师提前对访客说明，访客点头
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator briefs the visitors in advance and they nod.
shots.narration: 提前讲清会有什么声音，就不慌。

shots.scene: 车间里多个声音波纹图标，一个耳朵图标
shots.prompt_en: Several sound wave icons in a workshop and a large ear icon. No people.
shots.narration: 车间噪声大，时间长了伤听力。

shots.scene: 小研和访客戴上耳塞和耳罩
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the visitors put on earplugs and ear muffs.
shots.narration: 高噪声区域，戴好耳塞或耳罩。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现结霜、黄线、对话、耳罩四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside four icons: a frosted tank, a yellow floor line, a speech bubble, and ear muffs.
shots.narration: 结霜是预兆，访客站远点。

shots.scene: 王老师对访客讲解，大家站在黄线内
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains to the visitors as they all stand behind a yellow line.
shots.narration: 先告知再操作，不摸冷管，护好耳朵。

shots.scene: 欣欣和王老师、访客们在车间门口挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the safety administrator and the visitors at the workshop door.
shots.narration: 提前打招呼，参观更安心。
